workflowDefinition.name: SOC Argus — Arm Mythos-Class Preset
workflowDefinition.description:
Manual-only Argus Phase 1 deliverable. Arms the frontier-class adversary preset by enqueueing a pending attack command with difficulty=6 so the existing soc-caldera-dispatcher picks up the level-6 mythos-class-frontier-profile and launches the corresponding Caldera operation.
Why this exists:
  * soc-difficulty-controller only auto-escalates to level 5. Level 6 (Mythos-class)
    must be operator-armed for demos and adversarial eval runs — the whole point is
    that reaching L6 is a decision, not an accident.
  * Deterministic, non-LLM: just writes a command doc. The dispatcher, poller,
    difficulty controller, and trust-scorer already know how to react to difficulty=6
    via the seeded .soc-attack-profiles/level-6 profile.
  * Governance: every arm emits an .soc-audit-trail row so the event is recoverable
    from the shift-handover and Argus governance layer.

Inputs: none — always arms the canonical level-6 profile seeded by setup.sh from soc-simulation/caldera_profiles/level6-mythos-class.json.
Related Argus artifacts:
  * docs/argus/threat-model.html
  * docs/argus/mythos-preset-spec.md
  * docs/argus/issues/m2-4-frontier-simulation.md (Phase 2 — agentic extensions)

with.message: Argus Mythos-class preset armed (difficulty={{ consts.difficulty }}, profile={{ consts.operation_profile }}). Dispatcher will claim the command within ~1 minute.

_source.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Argus — Arm Mythos-Class Preset
description: >
  Manual-only Argus Phase 1 deliverable. Arms the frontier-class adversary preset by
  enqueueing a pending attack command with difficulty=6 so the existing
  soc-caldera-dispatcher picks up the level-6 mythos-class-frontier-profile and
  launches the corresponding Caldera operation.

  Why this exists:
    * soc-difficulty-controller only auto-escalates to level 5. Level 6 (Mythos-class)
      must be operator-armed for demos and adversarial eval runs — the whole point is
      that reaching L6 is a decision, not an accident.
    * Deterministic, non-LLM: just writes a command doc. The dispatcher, poller,
      difficulty controller, and trust-scorer already know how to react to difficulty=6
      via the seeded .soc-attack-profiles/level-6 profile.
    * Governance: every arm emits an .soc-audit-trail row so the event is recoverable
      from the shift-handover and Argus governance layer.

  Inputs: none — always arms the canonical level-6 profile seeded by setup.sh from
  soc-simulation/caldera_profiles/level6-mythos-class.json.

  Related Argus artifacts:
    * docs/argus/threat-model.html
    * docs/argus/mythos-preset-spec.md
    * docs/argus/issues/m2-4-frontier-simulation.md (Phase 2 — agentic extensions)

enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: manual

consts:
  difficulty: 6
  operation_profile: "mythos_class_frontier"

steps:
  - name: verify_profile_seeded
    type: elasticsearch.request
    with:
      method: GET
      path: "/.soc-attack-profiles/_doc/level-{{ consts.difficulty }}"

  - name: gate_profile_found
    type: console
    with:
      message: "{% if steps.verify_profile_seeded.output.found == true %}yes{% else %}no{% endif %}"

  - name: arm_attack_command
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-attack-commands
      refresh: "wait_for"
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        status: "pending"
        source: "soc-argus-arm-mythos-preset"
        difficulty: "{{ consts.difficulty }}"
        operation_profile: "{{ consts.operation_profile }}"
        argus:
          preset: "mythos_class_frontier"
          pressures_exercised: ["P1", "P2", "P3"]
          arm_reason: "manual_demo_or_eval"
    if: "steps.gate_profile_found.output: yes"

  - name: audit_arm
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-audit-trail
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
        event_type: argus_mythos_preset_armed
        source: "soc-argus-arm-mythos-preset"
        difficulty: "{{ consts.difficulty }}"
        operation_profile: "{{ consts.operation_profile }}"
        profile_found: "{{ steps.verify_profile_seeded.output.found | default: false }}"

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: >-
        Argus Mythos-class preset armed (difficulty={{ consts.difficulty }}, profile={{ consts.operation_profile }}).
        Dispatcher will claim the command within ~1 minute.
